title: Sample Explorer + Inline Fix-It Suggestions for Schema-First Onboarding
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Goal: Create a compact 'Sample Explorer' UI pattern for the Structured Output quickstart that lets users: (1) browse curated example inputs/outputs, (2) toggle between valid/invalid examples, and (3) surface contextual, inline 'fix-it' suggestions next to schema errors. The design should work as both a fullscreen quickstart step and as an embedded inline helper in the schema editor. Deliverables: annotated Figma frames, exportable PNGs for docs, and a short motion spec for the error-to-fix transition.
acceptance_criteria: Figma frames: Explorer list, Example detail panel, Inline error bubble, Fix-it suggestion tray
Three sample flows wired in prototype: valid example, syntax error example, semantic mismatch example
Accessible color contrast and copy reviewed by Content UX
Exported PNGs (2x) for docs: explorer-overview.png, fixit-inline.png
Developer Handoff: redlines + tokenized spacing and copy snippets in comment layer
comments: 2025-02-10 - Aisha Khan: Initial ticket created. Scope focuses on UX patterns that reduce onboarding time for schema-first users and lower error rates in first-run flows.
2025-02-11 - Marco Ortega: Early sketches uploaded to Figma. Decided to prioritize an inline 'fix-it' with code-friendly copy instead of a modal to keep context.
2025-02-13 - Content UX (Leila Morris): Reviewed copy — recommended shortening error messages and adding explicit 'why' lines for each fix-it suggestion.

2025-02-15 - Eng review (Ravi Patel): Confirmed runtime can return field-level validation messages via /schema/validate endpoint. Suggested we include a simple response example to speed implementation.
2025-02-16 - Design critique: Consolidated the detail panel to show example input, example output, and a toggle to view 'diff' highlighting mismatches. Motion spec added for diff fade-in.
2025-02-18 - PM sync (Jules Park): OK to ship as part of console-2025.02 if assets are ready by 02/25. Marked as release-ready pending final accessibility pass.
